root_cause_label: Editable Install Instead of Full Package Install
one_sentence_failure_summary: After the initial `pip install .` timed out at step 8, the agent never re-ran a proper installation; instead it manually copied compiled extensions and used `pip install -e . --no-deps` at step 24, which created an editable dev link rather than a globally-installed package, leaving the test harness unable to find the compiled Cython extensions.
t_err_evidence: At step 8, `pip install .` was executed without Cython being present; the output timed out mid-download (truncated at downloading sympy/mpmath) with no Cython extension compilation ever triggered. The agent moved on to source exploration at step 9 without retrying the install, anchoring a faulty build strategy from this point forward.
t_commit_evidence: At step 24, `pip install -e . --no-deps` was executed and succeeded, installing pyknotid only as an editable link to the local source directory. This choice permanently bypassed building and installing compiled Cython extensions into site-packages; no subsequent step re-attempted a proper `pip install .`.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge that Cython must be installed before `pip install .` will compile Cython extensions. At step 8 it ran the install without Cython, which caused setup.py to silently skip extension compilation and then time out on pure-Python dependency downloads. The agent then incorrectly diagnosed the timeout as a general install failure rather than recognizing that re-running `pip install .` after installing Cython (step 13) was the correct resolution.
forewarning_evidence: Step 5: `import numpy` raises ModuleNotFoundError, indicating the environment is not properly set up. Step 8: `pip install .` output truncates mid-download with no 'Successfully installed' message and no mention of Cython extension compilation, signaling the install never completed. Step 15: only 3 .so files found in build directory (cinvariants missing), showing the build was incomplete.
